text:
Alex: Quick sync — pricing asked for a lightweight framework to prioritize add-ons that customers request a lot but could cannibalize reserved revenue. Need a decision by EOD Tues.

Maria: Can we get the top 5 asks? CS / AMs should surface which ones are driving escalation.

Alex: CS list (summary): 1) higher soft cap for embeddings quota addon, 2) regional dedicated pools as an addon, 3) extended logs retention addon, 4) lower per-token for cached inference addon, 5) private model hosting as an addon. They want sequencing + gating.

Jordan: Key tradeoff: some low-cost add-ons reduce signal to upgrade to Dedicated. We need "revenue shielding" rules so we don't undercut commit contracts.

Priya: Proposed rule sketch: any add-on that is expected to reduce Dedicated conversion ARR by >5% requires: sales+rev ops approval, a canary rollout, and a 90-day trial measurement window.

Sam: Operational ask: add console guardrails (quota knobs, soft caps) and per-route metering to detect usage shift. Also we should capture NRR impact in first 90 days.

Alex: Draft launch criteria (suggestion):
```
- Product + Sales signoff
- Customer validation: 3 pilot customers (>= $50k ARR each)
- Guardrails: quota caps + billing opt-in + contract carveouts for reserved customers
- Metrics: 90-day delta in upgrade velocity and usage shift <= 7%
- Rollout: canary 5% orgs -> 25% -> GA; automatic rollback if upgrade velocity drops >5%
```

Maria: +1. Need playbook for discounts/carveouts in contracts so AEs don't give blanket discounts to avoid churn. Also mapping of which tiers get which add-ons.

Jordan: Engineering ops concerns: telemetry, per-route cost visibility, and an automatic fallback path (hosted model variant) if Dedicated utilization drops dangerously. @eng-runtime-bot can we support a "revenue-protect" deployment flag?

eng-runtime-bot: Noted. We can expose per-route chargeback metrics and a "revenue-protect" boolean on deployments that enforces quota caps and prevents auto-burst to cheaper variants. Rough estimate: 2 sprints for API + console surface.

Priya: Quick naming poll: "Revenue Shield" sounds blunt. Suggestions? "Priority Capacity Shielding", "Commit Protection Add-on", "Reserved Guard" :thinking:  

Alex: Naming aside — action items: Maria to prioritize CS list and send pilot candidate list; Sam to draft guardrail UX + console sketches; eng-runtime to scope revenue-protect flag and telemetry; Pricing to draft contract clause language for carveouts. Meeting Wed 10am to review.

Maria: On it.

Sam: Will have sketches by Tue end of day.

eng-runtime-bot: Created INF-4512: implement revenue-protect flag + per-route chargeback metrics.

Alex: Thanks everyone :rocket:
